title: "Kantsoner uten vegetasjon langs vassdrag i lavlandet"
author: "Jenny Hansen"

Load required libraries

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(duckdb)
library(DBI)
library(glue)
library(mapview)
library(terra)
library(igraph)

```

Import data

```{r echo=FALSE}

# Akershus boundary
akershus <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/AdministrativeUnits/Norway_AdministrativeUnits/Original/Norway_County/versjon2024/Administrative_enheter_fylker_2024_FGDB-format/Basisdata_32_Akershus_25832_Fylker2024_FGDB.gdb", layer = "fylke")

# FKB-Vann (buffer by 10 m) 
vassdrag <- st_read("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/FKB-Vann_Akershus.gpkg", layer = "fkbvann") %>% 
  select(OBJECTID, objtype) %>% 
  filter(objtype %in% c("ElvBekk", "Elvekant", "Innsjøkant")) %>% 
  st_buffer(10)

# Forest data (AR5)
skog <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/Topography/Norway_FKB/Original/FKB-AR5 FGDB-format/Basisdata_32_Akershus_25832_FKB-AR5_FGDB.gdb", layer = "fkb_ar5_omrade") %>% 
  filter(arealtype == 30) %>% 
  select(lokalid, arealtype) %>% 
  rename(geom = SHAPE)

# fjellområde (fra: https://nedlasting.miljodirektoratet.no/Fjellavgrensing/Fjellarealet_i_Norge.pdf)
fjell <- st_read("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/Fjell_norge_publisering.gdb", layer = "Modellert_fjell_50") %>% 
  st_transform(25832) %>% 
  st_filter(akershus, .predicate = st_intersects) %>% 
  st_intersection(akershus)

# invasive species raster
invasive <- rast("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/invasive_neighborhood.tif")

# pollinator prediction raster
poll <- rast("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/polliland_akershus.tif")
```

Remove vassdrag inside fjellområder

```{r}

# filter for features that do not intersect fjell
v_outside_fjell <- vassdrag %>% 
  st_filter(fjell, .predicate = st_disjoint)

```

Export data for out of session SQL intersection

```{r}

# skog
st_write(skog, "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/skog.shp")

# buffered vassdrag outside of fjell
st_write(v_outside_fjell, "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/vassdrag.shp")

```

Set up db connection and parameters

```{r}

con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
dbExecute(con, "INSTALL spatial FROM core_nightly; LOAD spatial;")

skog_path <- "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/skog.shp"
vass_path <- "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/vassdrag.shp"

dbExecute(con, 
          glue("CREATE TABLE skog AS SELECT * FROM ST_Read('{skog_path}')"))
dbExecute(con, 
          glue("CREATE TABLE vass AS SELECT * FROM ST_Read('{vass_path}')"))

dbGetQuery(con, "describe skog")
dbGetQuery(con, "describe vass")

```

Remove vassdrag adjacent to skog

```{r}

query <- "
  WITH candidate_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
      v.OBJECTID,
      s.lokalid,
      v.geom AS vass_geom,
      s.geom AS skog_geom
    FROM vass AS v, skog AS s
    WHERE ST_Disjoint(v.geom, s.geom)
  )
  SELECT 
    v.OBJECTID,
    ST_AsWKB(v.geom) AS geom_wkb
  FROM vass v
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM skog s
    WHERE ST_Intersects(v.geom, s.geom)
)
"

res <- dbSendQuery(con, query)
vass_outside_skog <- dbFetch(res) # n = 23,278
dbClearResult(res)

# convert to sf object
geom_sfc <- st_as_sfc(vass_outside_skog$geom_wkb, 
                      crs = 25832)

vass_kant_uten_skog <- vass_outside_skog %>%
  select(-geom_wkb) %>%
  mutate(geometry = geom_sfc) %>%
  st_sf()
```

Extract invasive species data

```{r echo=FALSE}

vkus_vect_inv <- vect(vass_kant_uten_skog)

# extract mean invasive
res_inv  <- extract(invasive, vkus_vect_inv, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
vkus_vect_inv$mean_invasive <- res_inv[,2]

# convert to sf
vkus_inv_sf <- st_as_sf(vkus_vect_inv)
```

Extract pollinator data

```{r echo=FALSE}

vkus_vect_poll <- vect(vkus_inv_sf)

# extract mean invasive
res_poll  <- extract(poll, vkus_vect_poll, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
vkus_vect_poll$mean_poll <- res_poll[,2]

# convert to sf
vkus_combined_sf <- st_as_sf(vkus_vect_poll)
```

Find most suitable areas

```{r echo=FALSE}

hist(vkus_combined_sf$mean_invasive)
hist(vkus_combined_sf$mean_poll)
summary(vkus_combined_sf$mean_invasive) # median 0, mean 0.96
summary(vkus_combined_sf$mean_poll) # median 3.52, mean 3.7

# filter for areas with higher potential for pollinators and invasive species
vkus_suitable <- vkus_combined_sf %>% 
  filter(mean_invasive >= 0.96,
         mean_poll >= 3.7) %>% 
  st_make_valid()

# identify intersecting polygons
nb <- st_intersects(vkus_suitable)

# convert to graph
g <- graph_from_adj_list(nb)

# find connected components
groups <- components(g)$membership

# dissolve using a weighted mean for value columns
vkus_dissolved <- vkus_suitable %>% 
  mutate(area = as.numeric(st_area(.))) %>% 
  mutate(group_id = groups) %>% 
  group_by(group_id) %>% 
  summarise(mean_invasive = weighted.mean(mean_invasive, area, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_poll = weighted.mean(mean_poll, area, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(area = as.numeric(st_area(.)))
```

Filter for areas 1000 sq. m or larger

```{r echo=FALSE}

vkus_filtered <- vkus_dissolved %>% 
  filter(area >= 1000) # n = 513
mapview(vkus_filtered)
```

Export data

```{r echo=FALSE}

# write to scratch temporarily and copy to P drive
out_gpkg <- "/data/scratch/tmp_jenny/gpkg/vassdrag_kant_lavland_uten_vegetasjon.gpkg"
st_write(vkus_filtered, out_gpkg, layer = "kantsoner_vassdrag")

file.copy(
  from = out_gpkg,
  to = "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Kriteriekart/vassdrag_kant_lavland_uten_vegetasjon.gpkg",
  overwrite = TRUE)

```
